design.title: Show it the whole city: full-lattice streaming with fresh per-visit rotations under the classify-then-refine head
design.eli5: This model is supposed to know Berlin by heart, but until now we only ever showed it the same 8% of the city's flashcards, over and over, each photographed from a single fixed compass heading. The best model so far could therefore only recognize the neighborhoods it had actually seen. This experiment changes nothing about the model itself — it just changes study habits: every pass now walks over every spot on the entire map, and each time a spot comes up, the photo is spun to a new random heading, the way a drone would actually see it. If you want something memorized, you have to show it all of it.
design.hypothesis: The champion's remaining error is dominated by what it was never shown, not by its architecture. train.py still samples 6000 of the ~70,000 train-lattice vantages ONCE, freezes a single rotation per crop, and replays those 6000 static images for 8 epochs — so ~92% of Berlin's lattice is never seen by a model whose entire job is to memorize the map, and every seen vantage is memorized at exactly one heading while eval views carry arbitrary rotations. Experiment 3 established that fixing this diet helps even under the worst possible head: full-lattice streaming improved geomean 1780.5 -> 1672.5 m with the centre-guessing (u,v) regressor, and its pre-registered follow-up was to retry the same regime under experiment 2's classification head. Experiment 4 restored that head (1780.5 -> 1323.6 m, 8% of viewpoints within 100 m) but still on the 8%-coverage diet — meaning its 8% hit population can only come from cells near the 6000 shown crops. The two validated mechanisms have never been combined. Streaming every lattice vantage each epoch, with a freshly drawn rotation on every visit, gives the cell classifier training evidence for all ~1024 cells and rotation-invariant evidence per vantage; the hit population should grow roughly in proportion to coverage, which is exactly what the geometric mean rewards.
